experience_description: Jjimjilbang is a traditional and distinctive Korean sauna and therapeutic complex featuring hot tubs alternating with cold baths and dry sauna rooms using various specialized ingredients to effectively detoxify the body and promote relaxation.

Originating from the Joseon era (late 14th century to early 19th century) with a system of water sourced from natural mineral springs, traditional Jjimjilbang was initially considered a secret recipe for curing ailments, rejuvenation, and beauty practices among the upper class.

The modern Jjimjilbang model began to develop from the 1990s in Busan. With interesting communal spaces, diverse sauna room experiences, numerous amenities, and high-quality services, providing instant relaxation and refreshment, Jjimjilbang quickly became a new mainstream cultural feature, a definite must-try experience when visiting Korea.
usage_instructions: No need to wait in line, customers can purchase tickets through the web, app, and use facial recognition to receive tickets or easily purchase them on-site with the fast and efficient smart ticket vending machines.
Utilize the smart key wristband provided at the locker area, which syncs with the admission ticket.
Scan the smart wristband to retrieve clothes and towels at the fabric counter at the entrance to the male and female sauna areas.
Upon finishing the experience, customers change clothes, return clothes and towels, then swipe the wristband to settle all additional services at the self-service payment counter.
With the smart payment wristband, a single touch is all it takes for customers to pay for all utility services at Aquafield such as dining, spa, etc.
Enjoy moments of relaxation in the therapy area. Customers can purchase necessary personal items from vending machines and pay with the smart wristband.

experience_description: VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment and relaxation paradise is well-known for its world-class games. Come along now to explore and play the must-try games!
1. The longest sea-crossing cable car route in the world

(Since October 29, 2021, VinWonders Nha Trang’s cable car service has been temporarily suspended for periodic maintenance until further notice and replaced with a speedboat service to shuttle visitors.)
Admire the stunning scenery of Nha Trang Bay - one of the 29 most beautiful bays on the planet from the world’s longest cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang.

Floating in the air and admiring the fantastic natural scenery from a cable car is a fabulous experience for every visitor to Nha Trang coastal city. From an altitude of 54 meters, you can appreciate the blue sea with a meandering pristine white sand beach embracing the beautiful coastal city. Another exciting information, the sea-crossing cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang has also been recognized wonder of the world in the heart of this romantic bay. You will feel you are wandering in a fairy-tale land when enjoying the natural scenery under the world’s longest sea-crossing cable car route.
2. Vietnam’s first-ever "million-dollar" multimedia masterpiece - Tata Show

The show left a profound impression right from its debut using the state-of-the-art 3D mapping protection technology on a giant 65m-high castle. For the first time in Vietnam, you can feast your eyes on the world’s highest-resolution million-dollar projection technology with extremely intense high-power laser light. Hundreds of international actors and actresses are involved in the show, promising to escort the audience on a specular journey in the fantasy world of VinWonders Nha Trang.
3. Zipline – the only holder of 3 Vietnam records

Enjoy “flying in the blue sky” at Zipline in VinWonders Land Nha Trang - holder of 3 records: the longest 880-meter and steepest 130-meter Zipline with a landing jump from the highest altitude of 5.8m in Vietnam. Most prominently, the record-breaking steepness will satisfy thrill-seekers with a superfast “flying” speed on the slide of up to 100 km/h.
4. Splash Bay, Vietnam’s largest floating bay that ranks top 2 in the world

Visitors to Nha Trang water entertainment paradise should not miss out on the 4,200-square-meter Splash Bay at VinWonders Nha Trang. With a colorful design, Splash Bay has a capacity of up to 750 visitors. It features an abundance of fun-filled games, such as balance bridge, action tower, cliff climbing, giant balloon, basins, rollers, beam swings, slides and swings. Feel safe to explore many adventure games as an on-duty professional rescue force is available at all times to assist you.
5. Vietnam’s largest Sky Wheel

With a height of 120 meters, VinWonders Sky Wheel has been recognized as the biggest of its kind in Vietnam and one of the world’s top ten most giant Ferris wheels, on par with well-known Melbourne Star (Australia) and Sky Dream Fukuoka (Japan). As a new symbol of Nha Trang Bay, the giant Sky Wheel has 60 advanced cabins, accommodating up to 480 passengers per trip. Do not hesitate to try this fantastic game. From atop Vinpearl Sky Wheel, your heart will be filled with excitement and wonder as you admire the majestic view of one of the world’s most beautiful bays in Hon Tre, Nha Trang.
6. Thrilling games in VinWonders Nha Trang
Once you set foot on the island, the enchanting square is the first thing you can see. For those who enjoy adventure, the thrilling games here are worth a try.

Thrilling games at VinWonders Nha Trang, such as acrobatic swings, roller coasters, and Swing Carousel, will blow the mind of thrill-seekers. Experience everything in VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment paradise to see that you get your money’s worth. A wide range of slides, such as the Black Hole, Kamikaze, and especially the super-speed Boomerang, will see you journey into the utmost and extreme thrill, like falling freely from a height of 26m.
7. What is enjoyable at VinWonders Nha Trang water park and aquarium?

Spread over 50,000 square meters, VinWonders Nha Trang water park is Vietnam’s first-ever sea-based freshwater park. It promises to completely satisfy you with a giant system of games falling into three separate areas: family, children and thrilling game areas.

Moreover, VinWonders Nha Trang Aquarium is also a must-see attraction. Experience walking in the vast ocean at the aquarium to admire captivating mermaids leisurely swimming in the sea and enjoying spectacular musical water fountain shows. Together combining in a joyful symphony will provide you with a second-to-none experience.

experience_description: Jjimjilbang is a traditional and distinctive Korean sauna and therapeutic complex featuring hot tubs alternating with cold baths and dry sauna rooms using various specialized ingredients to effectively detoxify the body and promote relaxation.

Originating from the Joseon era (late 14th century to early 19th century) with a system of water sourced from natural mineral springs, traditional Jjimjilbang was initially considered a secret recipe for curing ailments, rejuvenation, and beauty practices among the upper class.

The modern Jjimjilbang model began to develop from the 1990s in Busan. With interesting communal spaces, diverse sauna room experiences, numerous amenities, and high-quality services, providing instant relaxation and refreshment, Jjimjilbang quickly became a new mainstream cultural feature, a definite must-try experience when visiting Korea.

Since ancient times, humans have known to use mineral mud for health, beauty, and treatment. With the development of tourism services, Mud Bathing – Mineral Bathing remains the most “exciting” and beloved type of tourism.

diverse service packages to meet all guest needs
rational zoning
and an open design interspersed with regulation ponds within a lush green campus, it ensures guests have the most enjoyable and relaxing moments when visiting Hon Tam Mud Bath.

Hon Tam mineral mud contains many elements such as iron, carbon, calcium, mineral salts, etc., which have a positive impact on human skin. With strict international standard processing, the mineral mud is guaranteed to be sterilized with abundant mineral content.

Guests will shower to clean their bodies. After wetting their bodies, guests will soak in individual mineral mud baths for 10 to 20 minutes. This process helps the body absorb the essence of the mineral mud, promoting relaxation and softening the skin.

experience_description: EXPERIENCE THE MUD BATH AT THE LARGEST MINERAL HOT SPRING RESORT IN VIETNAM

Since ancient times, humans have known how to use mineral mud for health, beauty, and healing. With the development of tourism services, Mud Bath – Mineral Hot Spring has always been the most sought-after and beloved type of "exciting" tourism.

When mentioning Nha Trang tourism, no one can forget the "Mineral Hot Spring Mud Bath" service, famous as a "signature" of the province's tourism industry. Therefore, Hon Tam Mud Bath was born, contributing to enriching the tourism service on the island and offering guests a priceless gift from nature.
Inspired by a terraced rice field design, with a total area of up to 16,000m2
diverse service packages to meet all tourist needs
reasonable zoning
open design, interspersed with regulating lakes within a cool green space, helping guests enjoy wonderful moments of relaxation when visiting Hon Tam Mud Bath.
Health care with mud bath therapy

Hon Tam mineral mud contains many elements such as iron, carbon, calcium, mineral salts, etc., which have positive effects on human skin. With strict international standard processing, the mineral mud is guaranteed to be sterilized with abundant mineral content.

Guests will be showered to cleanse their bodies. After wetting the body, guests begin to soak in a private mineral mud bath for 10 to 20 minutes. This process helps the body absorb the essence of the mineral mud, promoting relaxation and softening the skin.

experience_description: VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment and relaxation paradise is well-known for its world-class games. Come along now to explore and play the must-try games!
1. The longest sea-crossing cable car route in the world

(Since October 29, 2021, VinWonders Nha Trang’s cable car service has been temporarily suspended for periodic maintenance until further notice and replaced with a speedboat service to shuttle visitors.)
Admire the stunning scenery of Nha Trang Bay - one of the 29 most beautiful bays on the planet from the world’s longest cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang.

Floating in the air and admiring the fantastic natural scenery from a cable car is a fabulous experience for every visitor to Nha Trang coastal city. From an altitude of 54 meters, you can appreciate the blue sea with a meandering pristine white sand beach embracing the beautiful coastal city. Another exciting information, the sea-crossing cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang has also been recognized wonder of the world in the heart of this romantic bay. You will feel you are wandering in a fairy-tale land when enjoying the natural scenery under the world’s longest sea-crossing cable car route.
2. Vietnam’s first-ever "million-dollar" multimedia masterpiece - Tata Show

The show left a profound impression right from its debut using the state-of-the-art 3D mapping protection technology on a giant 65m-high castle. For the first time in Vietnam, you can feast your eyes on the world’s highest-resolution million-dollar projection technology with extremely intense high-power laser light. Hundreds of international actors and actresses are involved in the show, promising to escort the audience on a specular journey in the fantasy world of VinWonders Nha Trang.
3. Zipline – the only holder of 3 Vietnam records

Enjoy “flying in the blue sky” at Zipline in VinWonders Land Nha Trang - holder of 3 records: the longest 880-meter and steepest 130-meter Zipline with a landing jump from the highest altitude of 5.8m in Vietnam. Most prominently, the record-breaking steepness will satisfy thrill-seekers with a superfast “flying” speed on the slide of up to 100 km/h.
4. Splash Bay, Vietnam’s largest floating bay that ranks top 2 in the world

Visitors to Nha Trang water entertainment paradise should not miss out on the 4,200-square-meter Splash Bay at VinWonders Nha Trang. With a colorful design, Splash Bay has a capacity of up to 750 visitors. It features an abundance of fun-filled games, such as balance bridge, action tower, cliff climbing, giant balloon, basins, rollers, beam swings, slides and swings. Feel safe to explore many adventure games as an on-duty professional rescue force is available at all times to assist you.
5. Vietnam’s largest Sky Wheel

With a height of 120 meters, VinWonders Sky Wheel has been recognized as the biggest of its kind in Vietnam and one of the world’s top ten most giant Ferris wheels, on par with well-known Melbourne Star (Australia) and Sky Dream Fukuoka (Japan). As a new symbol of Nha Trang Bay, the giant Sky Wheel has 60 advanced cabins, accommodating up to 480 passengers per trip. Do not hesitate to try this fantastic game. From atop Vinpearl Sky Wheel, your heart will be filled with excitement and wonder as you admire the majestic view of one of the world’s most beautiful bays in Hon Tre, Nha Trang.
6. Thrilling games in VinWonders Nha Trang
Once you set foot on the island, the enchanting square is the first thing you can see. For those who enjoy adventure, the thrilling games here are worth a try.

Thrilling games at VinWonders Nha Trang, such as acrobatic swings, roller coasters, and Swing Carousel, will blow the mind of thrill-seekers. Experience everything in VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment paradise to see that you get your money’s worth. A wide range of slides, such as the Black Hole, Kamikaze, and especially the super-speed Boomerang, will see you journey into the utmost and extreme thrill, like falling freely from a height of 26m.
7. What is enjoyable at VinWonders Nha Trang water park and aquarium?

Spread over 50,000 square meters, VinWonders Nha Trang water park is Vietnam’s first-ever sea-based freshwater park. It promises to completely satisfy you with a giant system of games falling into three separate areas: family, children and thrilling game areas.

experience_description: VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment and relaxation paradise is well-known for its world-class games. Come along now to explore and play the must-try games!
1. The longest sea-crossing cable car route in the world

(Since October 29, 2021, VinWonders Nha Trang’s cable car service has been temporarily suspended for periodic maintenance until further notice and replaced with a speedboat service to shuttle visitors.)
Admire the stunning scenery of Nha Trang Bay - one of the 29 most beautiful bays on the planet from the world’s longest cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang.

Floating in the air and admiring the fantastic natural scenery from a cable car is a fabulous experience for every visitor to Nha Trang coastal city. From an altitude of 54 meters, you can appreciate the blue sea with a meandering pristine white sand beach embracing the beautiful coastal city. Another exciting information, the sea-crossing cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang has also been recognized wonder of the world in the heart of this romantic bay. You will feel you are wandering in a fairy-tale land when enjoying the natural scenery under the world’s longest sea-crossing cable car route.
2. Vietnam’s first-ever "million-dollar" multimedia masterpiece - Tata Show

The show left a profound impression right from its debut using the state-of-the-art 3D mapping protection technology on a giant 65m-high castle. For the first time in Vietnam, you can feast your eyes on the world’s highest-resolution million-dollar projection technology with extremely intense high-power laser light. Hundreds of international actors and actresses are involved in the show, promising to escort the audience on a specular journey in the fantasy world of VinWonders Nha Trang.
3. Zipline – the only holder of 3 Vietnam records

Enjoy “flying in the blue sky” at Zipline in VinWonders Land Nha Trang - holder of 3 records: the longest 880-meter and steepest 130-meter Zipline with a landing jump from the highest altitude of 5.8m in Vietnam. Most prominently, the record-breaking steepness will satisfy thrill-seekers with a superfast “flying” speed on the slide of up to 100 km/h.
4. Splash Bay, Vietnam’s largest floating bay that ranks top 2 in the world

Visitors to Nha Trang water entertainment paradise should not miss out on the 4,200-square-meter Splash Bay at VinWonders Nha Trang. With a colorful design, Splash Bay has a capacity of up to 750 visitors. It features an abundance of fun-filled games, such as balance bridge, action tower, cliff climbing, giant balloon, basins, rollers, beam swings, slides and swings. Feel safe to explore many adventure games as an on-duty professional rescue force is available at all times to assist you.
5. Vietnam’s largest Sky Wheel

With a height of 120 meters, VinWonders Sky Wheel has been recognized as the biggest of its kind in Vietnam and one of the world’s top ten most giant Ferris wheels, on par with well-known Melbourne Star (Australia) and Sky Dream Fukuoka (Japan). As a new symbol of Nha Trang Bay, the giant Sky Wheel has 60 advanced cabins, accommodating up to 480 passengers per trip. Do not hesitate to try this fantastic game. From atop Vinpearl Sky Wheel, your heart will be filled with excitement and wonder as you admire the majestic view of one of the world’s most beautiful bays in Hon Tre, Nha Trang.
6. Thrilling games in VinWonders Nha Trang
Once you set foot on the island, the enchanting square is the first thing you can see. For those who enjoy adventure, the thrilling games here are worth a try.

Thrilling games at VinWonders Nha Trang, such as acrobatic swings, roller coasters, and Swing Carousel, will blow the mind of thrill-seekers. Experience everything in VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment paradise to see that you get your money’s worth. A wide range of slides, such as the Black Hole, Kamikaze, and especially the super-speed Boomerang, will see you journey into the utmost and extreme thrill, like falling freely from a height of 26m.
7. What is enjoyable at VinWonders Nha Trang water park and aquarium?

Spread over 50,000 square meters, VinWonders Nha Trang water park is Vietnam’s first-ever sea-based freshwater park. It promises to completely satisfy you with a giant system of games falling into three separate areas: family, children and thrilling game areas.

Moreover, VinWonders Nha Trang Aquarium is also a must-see attraction. Experience walking in the vast ocean at the aquarium to admire captivating mermaids leisurely swimming in the sea and enjoying spectacular musical water fountain shows. Together combining in a joyful symphony will provide you with a second-to-none experience.

The World's Longest Sea-Crossing Cable Car (VinWonders Nha Trang cable car will be temporarily suspended from October 29, 2021, until further notice for periodic maintenance and will be replaced by a high-speed boat service for visitor transportation.) Come and experience the sensation of admiring the panoramic view of Nha Trang Bay – one of the 29 most beautiful bays on the planet – on the world's longest cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang. Considered an unmissable experience when booking a tour to the beautiful coastal city of Nha Trang, while on the cable car, you will enjoy the feeling of floating in the air and admiring the beautiful natural scenery from a new perspective. From a height of 54m, the clear blue sea water with pristine white sandy beaches gently embraces the beautiful city. Furthermore, the sea-crossing cable car of VinWonders Nha Trang is itself a world-class wonder amidst the poetic bay. While enjoying the natural scenery below and experiencing the world's longest sea-crossing cable car, you will feel like you are strolling through a fairyland. 2. Vietnam's First "Million-Dollar" Multimedia Live Show The show has officially launched with an impressive display of the largest-scale 3D mapping technology in the South projected onto a colossal 65m-high castle. For the first time in Vietnam, you can witness the world's highest resolution projection technology, valued at millions of dollars, with extremely powerful laser intensity. The show features hundreds of professional international dancers, promising to take audiences on an overwhelming journey of experience in the magical Kingdom of VinWonders Nha Trang. 3. Zipline Holding Three Unique Records in Vietnam The zipline at VinWonders Land Nha Trang has been officially recognized by Vietnam for its longest continuous length of up to 880m, the steepest incline of 130m, and a landing drop of 5.8m. Particularly with its record-breaking slope, adventure enthusiasts will be truly satisfied as the speed on the zipline can reach up to 100km/h. 4. Vietnam's Largest Floating Bay, Top 2 in the World Nha Trang is a paradise for water activities and entertainment, making the floating bay at VinWonders Nha Trang, with a total area of 4,200m2, an unmissable destination. Designed with vibrant colors, the floating bay (Splash Bay) can accommodate up to 750 people simultaneously with a variety of games: balance beams, action towers, rock climbing walls, giant inflatable balls, bowls, rollers, monkey bars, slides, swings, and more. Visitors can confidently explore the adventurous games as a professional rescue team is always on standby to assist. 5. Vietnam's Largest Sky Wheel Ranked among the top 10 tallest Ferris wheels in the world, the VinWonders Sky Wheel stands at 120m tall and holds a Guinness World Record for the Largest Ferris Wheel in Vietnam, comparable to famous wheels like the Melbourne Star (Australia) and Sky Dream Fukuoka (Japan), becoming a new icon on Nha Trang Bay. Located at VinWonders Nha Trang, this giant Ferris wheel features 60 modern cabins, with a capacity of up to 480 passengers per ride. From the top cabin of the Sky Wheel, you will enjoy a breathtaking view of one of the most beautiful bays in the world. The thrill, excitement, and awe experienced at the top of the VinWonders Sky Wheel will be a one-of-a-kind experience only at Hon Tre Island, Nha Trang. 6. Thrill Rides at VinWonders Nha Trang With what this amusement paradise offers, the entrance ticket price for VinWonders Nha Trang is completely reasonable. Various slides such as the Black Hole, Kamikaze, and especially the Boomerang super-speed slide, will undoubtedly take players to the highest levels of excitement and exhilaration, similar to a free fall from a height of 26m. 7. What's at VinWonders Nha Trang's Water Park and Aquarium? With a total area of over 50,000m2 and being the first freshwater water park by the sea in Vietnam, the water park at VinWonders Nha Trang promises to bring you a refreshing feeling and absolute satisfaction. The game system is divided into 3 zones suitable for all ages and needs: family play area, children's area, and thrill-seeking area. In addition, the VinWonders Nha Trang aquarium is also a must-visit destination. Wandering through the aquarium, you will feel like you are walking in the vast ocean with beautiful mermaids gracefully swimming at the bottom of the sea, or vibrant water music performances. Everything blends into a joyful symphony, bringing you new and exciting experiences.

Experience everything in VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment paradise to see that you get your money’s worth. A wide range of slides, such as the Black Hole, Kamikaze, and especially the super-speed Boomerang, will see you journey into the utmost and extreme thrill, like falling freely from a height of 26m.

Experience walking in the vast ocean at the aquarium to admire captivating mermaids leisurely swimming in the sea and enjoying spectacular musical water fountain shows. Together combining in a joyful symphony will provide you with a second-to-none experience.

experience_description: VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment and relaxation paradise is well-known for its world-class games. Come along now to explore and play the must-try games!
1. The longest sea-crossing cable car route in the world

(Since October 29, 2021, VinWonders Nha Trang’s cable car service has been temporarily suspended for periodic maintenance until further notice and replaced with a speedboat service to shuttle visitors.)
Admire the stunning scenery of Nha Trang Bay - one of the 29 most beautiful bays on the planet from the world’s longest cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang.

Floating in the air and admiring the fantastic natural scenery from a cable car is a fabulous experience for every visitor to Nha Trang coastal city. From an altitude of 54 meters, you can appreciate the blue sea with a meandering pristine white sand beach embracing the beautiful coastal city. Another exciting information, the sea-crossing cable car route at VinWonders Nha Trang has also been recognized wonder of the world in the heart of this romantic bay. You will feel you are wandering in a fairy-tale land when enjoying the natural scenery under the world’s longest sea-crossing cable car route.
2. Vietnam’s first-ever "million-dollar" multimedia masterpiece - Tata Show

The show left a profound impression right from its debut using the state-of-the-art 3D mapping protection technology on a giant 65m-high castle. For the first time in Vietnam, you can feast your eyes on the world’s highest-resolution million-dollar projection technology with extremely intense high-power laser light. Hundreds of international actors and actresses are involved in the show, promising to escort the audience on a specular journey in the fantasy world of VinWonders Nha Trang.
3. Zipline – the only holder of 3 Vietnam records

Enjoy “flying in the blue sky” at Zipline in VinWonders Land Nha Trang - holder of 3 records: the longest 880-meter and steepest 130-meter Zipline with a landing jump from the highest altitude of 5.8m in Vietnam. Most prominently, the record-breaking steepness will satisfy thrill-seekers with a superfast “flying” speed on the slide of up to 100 km/h.
4. Splash Bay, Vietnam’s largest floating bay that ranks top 2 in the world

Visitors to Nha Trang water entertainment paradise should not miss out on the 4,200-square-meter Splash Bay at VinWonders Nha Trang. With a colorful design, Splash Bay has a capacity of up to 750 visitors. It features an abundance of fun-filled games, such as balance bridge, action tower, cliff climbing, giant balloon, basins, rollers, beam swings, slides and swings. Feel safe to explore many adventure games as an on-duty professional rescue force is available at all times to assist you.
5. Vietnam’s largest Sky Wheel

With a height of 120 meters, VinWonders Sky Wheel has been recognized as the biggest of its kind in Vietnam and one of the world’s top ten most giant Ferris wheels, on par with well-known Melbourne Star (Australia) and Sky Dream Fukuoka (Japan). As a new symbol of Nha Trang Bay, the giant Sky Wheel has 60 advanced cabins, accommodating up to 480 passengers per trip. Do not hesitate to try this fantastic game. From atop Vinpearl Sky Wheel, your heart will be filled with excitement and wonder as you admire the majestic view of one of the world’s most beautiful bays in Hon Tre, Nha Trang.
6. Thrilling games in VinWonders Nha Trang
Once you set foot on the island, the enchanting square is the first thing you can see. For those who enjoy adventure, the thrilling games here are worth a try.

Thrilling games at VinWonders Nha Trang, such as acrobatic swings, roller coasters, and Swing Carousel, will blow the mind of thrill-seekers. Experience everything in VinWonders Nha Trang entertainment paradise to see that you get your money’s worth. A wide range of slides, such as the Black Hole, Kamikaze, and especially the super-speed Boomerang, will see you journey into the utmost and extreme thrill, like falling freely from a height of 26m.
7. What is enjoyable at VinWonders Nha Trang water park and aquarium?

Spread over 50,000 square meters, VinWonders Nha Trang water park is Vietnam’s first-ever sea-based freshwater park. It promises to completely satisfy you with a giant system of games falling into three separate areas: family, children and thrilling game areas.

Moreover, VinWonders Nha Trang Aquarium is also a must-see attraction. Experience walking in the vast ocean at the aquarium to admire captivating mermaids leisurely swimming in the sea and enjoying spectacular musical water fountain shows. Together combining in a joyful symphony will provide you with a second-to-none experience.

details.overview: VinWonders Nha Trang, a paradise for entertainment, recreation, and relaxation, is renowned for its world-class rides and attractions. Come and experience the must-try zones when you visit this place! 1. The world's longest cross-sea cable car (The VinWonders Nha Trang cable car service is temporarily suspended from October 29, 2021, until further notice for periodic maintenance and will be replaced by a high-speed boat service to transport guests.) Come and experience the sensation of overlooking the entire Nha Trang Bay – one of the 29 most beautiful bays on the planet – on the world's longest cable car at VinWonders Nha Trang. Considered an unmissable experience when booking a tour to the beautiful coastal city of Nha Trang, while on the cable car, you will enjoy the feeling of floating in the air and admire the beautiful natural scenery from a novel perspective. From a height of 54m, you can see the clear blue sea with pristine white sandy beaches, winding as if embracing the beautiful city. Besides, the cross-sea cable car of VinWonders Nha Trang is also a world-class wonder amidst the poetic sea bay. While enjoying the natural scenery below, you will feel like you are wandering in a celestial realm while experiencing the world's longest cross-sea cable car ride. 2. Vietnam's first "million-dollar" multimedia spectacle show The show has officially launched with the unveiling of the most massive 3D mapping technology in the South on a gigantic 65m-high castle facade, creating a spectacular visual feast. For the first time in Vietnam, you can witness the world's highest resolution projection technology, valued at millions of dollars, with extremely powerful laser light intensity. The show features performances by hundreds of world-class international dancers, promising to take audiences on an overwhelming journey of experience at the Magical Kingdom of VinWonders Nha Trang. 3. Zipline holding three unique records in Vietnam The zipline at VinWonders Land Nha Trang has been officially recognized by Vietnam Records for its longest continuous run of 880m, highest slope of 130m, and a landing drop from a height of 5.8m. Especially with its record-breaking slope, thrill-seeking visitors will be truly satisfied as they reach speeds of up to 100km/h on the zipline. 4. Vietnam's largest floating bay, top 2 in the world Nha Trang is a paradise for water-based entertainment and activities, so the floating bay at VinWonders Nha Trang, with a total area of 4,200m², is a must-visit destination. Designed with vibrant colors, the floating bay (Splash Bay) can accommodate up to 750 people simultaneously with a variety of games: balance beams, action towers, rock climbing, giant inflatable balls, chutes, rollers, monkey bars, slides, swings, and more. Guests can confidently explore the thrilling games as professional lifeguards are always on duty to assist. 5. Vietnam's largest Sky Wheel Ranked among the top 10 tallest Ferris wheels in the world, the VinWonders Sky Wheel stands at 120m high and is recognized by Guinness World Records as the largest Ferris wheel in Vietnam, comparable to famous wheels like the Melbourne Star (Australia) and Sky Dream Fukuoka (Japan), becoming a new icon of Nha Trang Bay. Located at VinWonders Nha Trang, the giant Ferris wheel has 60 modern cabins, with a capacity of up to 480 passengers per rotation. From the top cabin of the Sky Wheel, you will have a panoramic view of the majestic landscape of one of the most beautiful bays in the world. The excitement, thrill, and awe of reaching the top of the VinWonders Sky Wheel will be a "one-of-a-kind" experience only at Hon Tre Island, Nha Trang. 6. Thrill rides at VinWonders Nha Trang With what this entertainment paradise offers, the ticket price for VinWonders Nha Trang is completely reasonable. Various types of slides such as the Cosmic Black Hole, Kamikaze, and especially the Boomerang super-speed slide, will surely take players to the highest levels of excitement and exhilaration, akin to a freefall from a height of 26m. 7. What to find at VinWonders Nha Trang's Water Park and Aquarium With a total area of over 50,000m² and being the first freshwater sea water park in Vietnam, the water park at VinWonders Nha Trang promises to bring you a refreshing feeling and absolute satisfaction. The game system is divided into 3 zones suitable for all ages and needs: family play area, children's area, and thrill-seeking area. In addition, the VinWonders Nha Trang aquarium is also a must-visit destination. Strolling through the aquarium, you will feel like you are walking in the vast ocean with beautiful mermaids gracefully swimming at the bottom of the ocean, or colorful water music performances. Everything blends into a joyful symphony, bringing you new experiences.
